body:
To feel balanced and centered, it is important to be grounded and connected to the energy of the Earth. The Grounding Anklet is a powerful piece to help ground your body's energy!

A simple way to become grounded is to visualize roots streaming from the bottom of your feet, growing downward and hooking you deep into the core of the earth. Breathe and visualize all negativity, panic and blockages flowing down through the roots and dissolving into Mother Earth. Visualize green healing light coming back up the roots through the soles of your feet, running up your legs to your groin and filling you with healing vibrating energy.

Hematine is a magnetic Lodestone that absorbs and transmutes negative energy, while providing a shield of protection. It is the most powerful and effective grounding gemstone. It also helps to eliminate negative emotions such as stress, panic and worry. As soon as you place this magnetic Hematine against your skin, you will immediately feel a shift in energy--it's unreal!

Affirmation: I am grounded and connected to Mother Earth.
